title: MnWO4: which competing exchanges make the paramagnetic half-moons

decision_points.fork: Which purchases determine the twelve exchange constants: the archived dispersion alone, or dispersion plus diffuse data
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit J1..J12, D to the 1.5 K spectra only (buying more spectra) and split the undetermined combination at minimum norm
decision_points.consequence: Along the archived [102]/[010] paths the AF1 spectrum depends on J3 and J11 only through J3 + J11 (exact null vector). The min-norm split J3 = J11 = -0.168 moves k_LT by 0.049 r.l.u. (tolerance 0.020) and puts the flat spiral 0.155 meV/Mn below AF1; the spectral fit is unchanged, so the error shows only after buying a map or a zone slice
decision_points.difficulty_type: underdetermined fit discovered by rank analysis; discriminating purchase under a binding budget; cascade into the ground state

decision_points.fork: How classical spin dynamics of 5 muB moments maps onto spin-wave energies
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat the unit-vector Hamiltonian as S = 1 spins (energies ~ J instead of J/S with S = 5/2)
decision_points.consequence: All J and D come out 0.4x too small; the 14 K map (r 0.72), the 5e map (0.81) and k_LT (off 0.031) fail; the spectra and the maps imply inconsistent exchange scales
decision_points.difficulty_type: convention exposed only by cross-checking two data types

decision_points.fork: Paramagnetic structure factor: spin-length-constrained (SCGA/MC) or mean-field RPA
decision_points.wrong_choice: Mean-field RPA susceptibility at the nominal temperatures (or at the lowest temperature where it is finite)
decision_points.consequence: RPA is singular below its mean-field temperature (~16 K); its 14 K map gives r 0.50 (0.81 at 17 K) and the strongly coupled reduced model 5e (easy-axis mean-field temperature ~21 K) gives r 0.31
decision_points.difficulty_type: model class; regime judgement near T_N

decision_points.fork: Whether the single-ion anisotropy is needed
decision_points.wrong_choice: Isotropic Heisenberg model (D = 0), J refitted to the same spectra
decision_points.consequence: The incommensurate spiral becomes the ground state and k_LT moves by 0.034 (fails); the paramagnetic maps barely change (r14 0.889), so the error is invisible in the diffuse data
decision_points.difficulty_type: confounder: anisotropy irrelevant above T_N but decisive for the ground state

decision_points.fork: What the archived structure factor contains
decision_points.wrong_choice: Apply the Mn2+ magnetic form factor (as in the experiment) to the predicted maps
decision_points.consequence: 14 K r 0.71, 5d r 0.29, 5e r 0.75: the archived |S| has no form factor (the purchased maps show no |q| decay)
decision_points.difficulty_type: evidence in the raw outputs (neutron convention)

decision_points.fork: Interpretation of the half-moons: classical spin-liquid local constraint (temperature-insensitive) or short-range order of competing 3D exchange
decision_points.wrong_choice: Spin-liquid view: the half-moons do not sharpen on cooling (use the 20 K map as the 14 K map) and do not depend on particular bonds
decision_points.consequence: 14 K r 0.83, 5d r 0.61, 5e r 0.79 and the wrong origin
decision_points.difficulty_type: competing explanation; transfer to a withheld temperature

decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep only the intra-chain couplings J1 and J4
decision_points.consequence: All maps fail (r 0.35-0.51), k_LT wrong, wrong origin

graded_fields: propagation_vector_rlu within 0.020 r.l.u. (max component, modulo sign and G) of the Luttinger-Tisza vector of the archived Hamiltonian
map_14K_prediction: Pearson r >= 0.85 with the archived 14 K block averages
reduced_model_predictions: 5d r >= 0.68, 5e r >= 0.88 against the archived 20 K block averages
not graded numerically (required, reviewed with the report): exchange_meV, anisotropy_D_meV, spiral_minus_af1_meV_per_Mn

length_estimate.why: Bond bookkeeping for a 2-site monoclinic cell with 12 paths, an 8-sublattice AF1 linear spin-wave code with anisotropy, robust fitting of noisy spectra, a rank/null-vector analysis, a 2-sublattice SCGA with anisotropy, Luttinger-Tisza minimisation and block-averaged map predictions.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); the lab is a lookup of archived UppASD outputs (data.npz, 3.1 MB), grading is numpy
notes: Adapted from the design: the lab serves the authors' archived UppASD outputs (spectra, maps, reduced-model maps, zone slices) instead of an LSWT/SCGA calculator, because the agent can run those itself and the budget would not bind. No synthetic data are generated: the archived spin-dynamics outputs of the authors' model are the 'measurements' and the experimental neutron data (not archived) are not used. Model T_N is not graded (no archived temperature sweep; the paper's ~11 K comes from heat-capacity runs that are not archived; it is a rubric item). The categorical 'three dominant bonds' target was replaced by predictions of the withheld reduced-model maps (paper Fig. 5d,e) plus the origin category, because a ranking of |J| is not stable (J4 -0.334 vs J9 -0.317). The withheld zone-boundary magnon energy was dropped: off-path energies would have to come from builder forward modelling, and on-path points are interpolation. Coordinator review (2026-10-20): individual J/D windows and the spiral-AF1 energy window were removed from grading. Without literature priors the archived data do not pin them: a spectra-only global search finds a solution that fits the 20 spectra better than the archived parameters (cost 109.5 vs 121.5, J1 = +0.02, D = -0.37) but fails the maps, and joint spectra+maps searches give J1 from -0.37 to -0.87 and spiral-AF1 from -0.076 to +0.048 meV/Mn while all reproducing the graded maps and k. The box-quantised/experimental k decision point (old dp5) was dropped from grading for the same reason (the k tolerance needed by non-recall fits, 0.020, accepts k_ic at 0.0157); it remains rubric item 7.
solution_route: Oracle (solve.py): 20 spectra fitted from the paper's rounded Table I as a starting point (fast and deterministic), J3 - J11 fixed by the 20/30 K maps, SCGA/LT predictions. Non-recall route (construction/.../nonrecall.py, fitlib.Joint): differential evolution over J1..J12, D and the SCGA temperature scale on 10 spectra + 20/30 K block maps + the 11 K ordering-peak constraint, joint polish, null scan; ~13 min single-threaded per seed. Best of 4 seeds by objective passes every graded check (k 0.0156, r14 0.917, 5d 0.721, 5e 0.910; listed in ROBUSTNESS); seed 1 also passes, seed 3 fails 5d/5e and seed 4 fails k (0.0214). Graded checks therefore do not depend on recalling literature values.
